events.subtitle: feat. Adam Deitch, Larry Goldings & Oteil Burbridge
events.factual_description: The Hamilton Live presents John Scofield's Electrospective on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 8:00 PM. Scofield is revisiting classic fusion-groove compositions from projects including Blue Matter, Uberjam and A Go Go, explicitly reinterpreting rather than reproducing them, with Oteil Burbridge on bass, Larry Goldings on keyboards and Adam Deitch on drums.

sources.name: The Hamilton Live authorized Eventim/See Tickets event page

provenance.note: The Hamilton Live's current listing verifies the October 22 date, 8:00 PM show time and live ticket status; its authorized event page verifies the venue, doors/show times, project concept and lineup. John Scofield's official site independently confirms the Washington date, Electrospective concept and personnel. Recommended listening links are exact Apple Music album pages tied directly to repertoire named in the event description.

en.why_it_matters: Scofield is not simply playing a career-spanning set: Electrospective deliberately returns to the groove/fusion language of Blue Matter, Uberjam and A Go Go without trying to reproduce the old bands. Oteil Burbridge, Larry Goldings and Adam Deitch are exactly the kind of players who can mutate that material in real time. In The Hamilton's intimate DC room, the appeal is the combination of a living master, an unusually focused repertory concept and a rhythm section built for elastic groove.
en.trip_verdict: S local/regional. Protect the night in DC. If coming from Baltimore or the nearer corridor, this is worth the drive specifically for the show; the project is special enough to anchor an evening, but because it is a multi-city tour it does not rise to S+.
en.listen_before: A Go Go; Blue Matter; Überjam Deux

es.why_it_matters: Scofield no viene simplemente a tocar un set retrospectivo: Electrospective regresa deliberadamente al lenguaje de groove/fusión de Blue Matter, Uberjam y A Go Go sin intentar copiar las bandas originales. Oteil Burbridge, Larry Goldings y Adam Deitch son precisamente músicos capaces de deformar ese material en tiempo real. En una sala íntima como The Hamilton, la combinación de maestro vivo, repertorio muy enfocado y una sección rítmica hecha para el groove lo vuelve especialmente Listening Notes.
es.trip_verdict: S local/regional. Hay que proteger la noche en DC. Desde Baltimore o el corredor cercano sí vale manejar específicamente por este show; el proyecto alcanza para anclar una noche, pero al ser una gira de varias ciudades no llega a S+.
es.listen_before: A Go Go; Blue Matter; Überjam Deux
